zh: 员工和权限。SuXin POS · 员工
en: Staff and what they may do

zh: 员工清单：每个人的角色和分店
填名字、email、密码，选角色和分店
en: Name, email, password, role and branch

zh: 员工也可以自己注册：用公司代码加入
en: Or staff sign up themselves with the company code

zh: 库存：每间分店现在有多少，低库存显示出来
en: Stock: what each branch has; low stock stands out

zh: 调整库存要选原因，每一笔都记录
en: Every stock change needs a reason and is logged
